resources.name: project-context
resources.description: Core project context for FastAPI applications
resources.content:
# FastAPI REST API

## Tech Stack
- Python 3.12+ with type hints on all functions
- FastAPI 0.110+
- SQLAlchemy 2.0 (async)
- Pydantic v2 for validation
- Alembic for migrations
- pytest with httpx for testing
- ruff for linting and formatting
- uv as package manager

## Commands
- `uv run fastapi dev` — Start dev server
- `uv run pytest` — Run tests
- `uv run alembic upgrade head` — Apply migrations
- `uv run ruff check .` — Lint
- `uv run ruff format .` — Format
- `uv run mypy .` — Type check

## Architecture
- `app/api/` — Route handlers
- `app/models/` — SQLAlchemy models
- `app/schemas/` — Pydantic schemas
- `app/core/` — Configuration and utilities
- `app/services/` — Business logic
- `tests/` — Mirrors app/ structure

## Conventions
- Type hints required on all functions
- Google style docstrings
- Async endpoints by default (async def)
- Dependency injection via FastAPI Depends()
- Line length: 88 characters (ruff default)
- Class names: PascalCase, functions/variables: snake_case

## Rules
- Watch for GPU memory leaks: call torch.cuda.empty_cache() after inference
- Never commit model weight files (.pt, .pth) to git
- All SQL queries use SQLAlchemy, no raw SQL
- Every endpoint needs integration tests

resources.name: api-design
resources.content:
# API Design Rules

- Every handler follows: validate -> execute -> respond
- Specify response_model on every endpoint
- Use zod/pydantic schemas colocated with the handler
- HTTP status codes: 200 (success), 201 (created), 400 (validation), 401 (auth), 404 (not found), 500 (server error)
- Pagination uses cursor-based approach with { cursor, limit } params
- Include OpenAPI documentation comments on all endpoints
